metadata.title: Examples of $\mathbb{Z}/2$-Harmonic 1-Forms
metadata.abstract: In this paper, we develop methods for constructing $\mathbb{Z}/2$-harmonic 1-forms in dimension three by varying the background metric. On $\mathbb{R}^3$, we construct an example for which the complement of the smooth locus in the singular set is a Cantor set. We realize every finite graph with positive even valence at each vertex as the monodromy locus of a $\mathbb{Z}/2$-harmonic 1-form on $B^3$. We also construct desingularization models for every critical $\mathbb{Z}/2$-eigensection, agreeing exactly with the associated homogeneous model outside a compact set. Finally, we construct a nondegenerate $\mathbb{Z}/2$-harmonic 1-form on every closed connected oriented three-manifold for a suitable smooth metric.

analysis.topic: 几何分析、几何 PDE 与几何流
analysis.workSummary: 通过改变背景度量构造三维 Z/2-调和1形式，允许奇异集非光滑部分为 Cantor 集，实现偶价有限图的单值轨迹，并构造去奇异化模型。
analysis.breakthrough: 在任意闭连通定向三流形上，为适当度量构造非退化例子，显示奇异结构可非常丰富。
analysis.limitations: 度量允许调整，不是任意预定度量下的存在定理；图实现要求各顶点正偶数价。 数学分析仅依据摘要和评论，未审读完整证明。 AI 披露另见独立全文检索及命中核查记录；未见披露不代表未使用 AI。
analysis.aiEvidence: 作者披露 GPT-5.5 Pro 和 GPT-5.6 Sol 辅助部分证明；作者核验数学论证并重新撰写稿件，声明承担全部责任。
